limits: All manifest-listed artifact-output JSONL/NDJSON files are checked for top-level CLI lifecycle events; model.json metadata is optional. Other formats, error-only unidentified logs, or unexported calls can remain unknown.
CLI stdout and agent metadata are reported usage, not independently captured provider billing; native confirmed totals are unchanged.
Unknown token fields are retained as null per thread; numeric aggregates are known lower bounds.
Reasoning is included in output, cached/cache-write input is included in input; total is input plus output.
Model and effort in model.json describe requested settings; CLI events do not establish actual model/effort.
Original ledgers and indexes are unchanged. Numeric deltas may recover known IDs without adding a thread; original incomplete lifecycle flags remain.
Observed tokens are a lower bound when any usage is missing or requests fail.
Native session response records are deduplicated by response_id; ephemeral threads use their last cumulative total.
The same native thread in a session, actor ledger and app-server events contributes once.
Agent-produced app-server notifications are consistency evidence, not cryptographic billing attestation.
Unlogged ephemeral calls or deliberately changed CODEX_HOME cannot be ruled out from exported evidence alone.
